title: Proposal to Resolve the stUSDS Liquidity Crisis Immediately: $40–50M Atomic OTC Debt-for-SKY Buyback
headline: A forum post proposes using $40-50M from Sky's surplus buffer or treasury for an atomic OTC buyback of SKY from stUSDS borrowers, with proceeds used to repay debt.
summary: The author says stUSDS is at about 100% utilization with roughly $159M trapped and secondary-market trading at about a 15% discount. The proposal: allocate $40-50M from the Surplus Buffer or Treasury to an atomic OTC buyback auction open to LSEV2-SKY-A borrowers. Borrowers would sell SKY to the protocol at a fixed or TWAP-anchored price (the post gives about $0.038 to $0.042) and the USDS proceeds would go straight to repaying debt in the Staking Engine. The author claims this would drop utilization to about 68 to 74%, reopen withdrawals and let the protocol hold or burn the SKY acquired. The post cites about $95M in reserves. These are the author's claims and estimates and are not verified here. Open questions: pricing, eligibility, size relative to reserves, and governance route.
risk_flags: pricing of SKY purchase not settled
